en.title: Spring AI 2.1 Tool Call Confirmation and Session Extensions 0.11.0
en.summary: Spring AI 2.1 introduces tool call confirmation to pause execution when the model requests a marked tool. Spring AI Session Extensions version 0.11.0 adds session turn status tracking so another process can resume a parked turn.

claims.text: Spring AI 2.1 introduces tool call confirmation to pause execution when the model requests a marked tool.

evidence.quote: Spring AI 2.1 adds tool call confirmation : you mark a tool, and the loop runs the harmless tools as before and pauses only when the model asks for a marked one.

claims.text: Spring AI Session Extensions version 0.11.0 adds session turn status tracking so another process can resume a parked turn.

evidence.quote: 0.11.0 is its first release, so its API can still change.
Session Extensions is a Spring AI Community project: it is developed outside the core project and released on its own schedule. 0.11.0 is its first release

ko.title: Spring AI 2.1 도구 호출 확인 및 Session Extensions 0.11.0
ko.summary: Spring AI 2.1은 모델이 표시된 도구를 요청할 때 실행을 일시 중지하는 도구 호출 확인 기능을 도입합니다. Spring AI Session Extensions 버전 0.11.0은 다른 프로세스가 일시 중지된 턴을 재개할 수 있도록 세션 턴 상태 추적을 추가합니다.
